mapper.sql: id, tenant_id, task_id, request_id, command_sha256, expected_revision, package_sha256, result_sha256, decision, previous_status, target_status, executor_stopped, not_deployed, artifacts_reviewed, migrations_reviewed, note, create_by, create_time, create_dept, update_by, update_time, del_flag
mapper.select: SELECT FROM sys_plugin_task_review WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND task_id = #{taskId} AND del_flag = 0 ORDER BY create_time DESC, id DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT t.id AS task_id, t.plugin_id, t.plugin_version, t.operation_type, t.task_status, t.active_plugin_id, t.revision, t.archive_sha256, t.preview_json, b.worker_id, b.source_commit, b.image, b.phase AS build_phase, b.finished_time, b.result_json, b.result_sha256, r.id AS review_id, r.expected_revision, r.package_sha256 AS review_package_sha256, r.result_sha256 AS review_result_sha256, r.decision, r.previous_status, r.target_status, r.executor_stopped, r.not_deployed, r.artifacts_reviewed, r.migrations_reviewed FROM sys_plugin_task t INNER JOIN sys_plugin_build b ON b.id = t.id AND b.tenant_id = t.tenant_id AND b.del_flag = 0 INNER JOIN sys_plugin_task_review r ON r.task_id = t.id AND r.tenant_id = t.tenant_id AND r.del_flag = 0 WHERE t.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND t.id = #{taskId} AND t.del_flag = 0 AND r.id = #{reviewId}
